_comment: Store catalogue, keyed by the requiredTags value the client asks for.
Observed tags on Dauntless 1.4.4: webstore, season09b_pass, season09b_rank,
loadout_slots, fountain_daily_free_bundle.
SKU shape is taken from the 1.4.4 executable's own field names, NOT from a
captured 2.x response. This client reads FLAT price fields (platinumPrice,
platinumSalePrice, cellDustPrice, prestigePrice, event01Price,
steelMarksPrice, gildedMarksPrice). It has no parser for the newer
prices:[{currencyId,price}] array - sending that yields an offer with no
recognisable price, which the client discards, giving an empty store.
Prices are 0: there is no real-money integration and none is planned.
1.4.4 category tags verified from live Default__store_view_model_C: feature and skin_armour.
webstore is the request filter; it does not place offers into a visible category.
Item IDs and stackability verified against the live 1.4.4 ArchonCatalog.

Tab positions: the store's tab bar indexes the full tab list, hidden tabs included, so any empty tab placed before a populated one shifts every later tab's content (e.g. EMOTES opening weapons). Offers therefore carry extra tags so your_offers, supplies_boost, personality_stylekit and personality_character are never empty.

Store tile art comes from the client's own StoreItemsTable (Archon_UI_0 pak, /Game/UI/Store/StoreItemsTable): 1,405 rows keyed by SKU id, each with FeatureImage/StandardImage. An offer shows art if and only if its id is a row with an image; anything else renders the generic samurai fallback.

Tile art must be 2:1. Store tiles are a fixed 2:1 frame. Real store art (StoreImages) is 512x256; the Hunt Pass reward icons many PRESTIGE_ rows point at are 512x512 or 256x512 and render stretched. store_art_skus.json lists only the SKUs whose tile texture is 2:1 (1.9-2.25), and a test holds every storefront id to it.

Grant kind (stacked or instanced) follows the live ArchonCatalog stackable flag, recorded per item in store_item_kinds.json. The real season09b config agrees with that flag for every item it grants. Armour is only sold where it is stackable, the case proven in game.

Repeatable offers: TOKEN_BOUNTY_DRAFT_PREMIUM (bounty_token_id's premium twin in /bounty/game-data - the purchased kind that persists across seasons) may be bought any number of times, in any positive quantity. Everything else is a one-time cosmetic unlock.

Sheens and premium hair tints are entitlement unlocks, not items. Their SKU -> entitlement pairs come from the client's own tables: /Game/Gameplay/dye_sheen_table and /Game/UI/Appearance/appearance_hair_colour_premium_table (columns SkuId and Entitlements). Native dye palette sets have no client-assigned contents; Revived defines the contents of its six palette offers below.
From github.com/Harmonicrain/Undaunted (895f7c7) by Harmonic, AGPL-3.0-only. Identifiers and tuning values read from the 1.4.4 client for interoperability; no game assets.

Dauntless Revived changes: season09b_rank is served empty (the fork's season09b_10_ranks offer granted CURRENCY_PRESTIGE, which the store cannot sell; a rank skip would be a progression grant). The repeatable bounty-token bundle is listed only with STORE_REPEATABLE_TOKENS=1. store_art_skus.json lives in test/data/, since only a test reads it. The store answers only with STORE=free.

Six Revived colour-dye packs use native palette SKU art rows; contents are explicitly defined here, not inferred retail bundle contents. Sheen offers remain archival data but are permanently blocked by IsListed.
